title: Wendy T NDE 7329
content: I remember standing next to the emergency room doctor who was screaming at several people while they shocked me over and over and over again. He wouldn't give up. I kept trying to tell him that I was okay and had never felt better. I wanted him to understand. But, the feeling that I had was that I understood everything (is as close as I can describe) and that this was much better. I slowly let go of all the pain and sorrow and yelling in that emergency room. I left that emergency room for a little while and I'm not sure what happened but I remember a very old man touching my hand and I was back in my body. I was on a ventilator when I woke up and then I developed pneumonia. After 2 or 3 days, the nurses made me get up and walk in the hallway. I saw the Doctor who had been screaming at everybody and wouldn't give up on me. I went up to him and thanked him for saving my life. All the blood drained out of his face and I think we both realized, at the same time, that we had never met when I was alive. I was unconscious when a man in a dream told me he would take care of him for me. I had this warm, cozy feeling that everything was alright and when I awoke I was so happy.

arrival.other_being_detail: A "very old man" touched her hand.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: She remembers a very old man touching her hand and then she was back in her body.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: She reports being out of body observing resuscitation, leaving the ER "for a little while," then returning to her body after an old man touched her hand.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE observing resuscitation; leaves the ER briefly (unclear what occurred); returns to body after an old man touches her hand.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Afterward, when she thanked the doctor for saving her life, they realized they had never met while she was alive; she also reports being unconscious when a man in a dream told her he would take care of the doctor for her.
